title: Long-Wearing Cream Eyeshadow Duo Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Shimmer Finish✓ Medium Coverage✓ Long-wearing✓ Matte Finish✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Cream Formula

What it is: A limited-edition gift set featuring Mario’s Master Mattes® & Soft Shimmer™ Long-Wear Cream Eyeshadows.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. These products are also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This set includes two weightless cream eyeshadows with a diffused matte or soft shimmer finish. They are crease-resistant, sweat- and humidity-resistant, and waterproof.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use the doe-foot applicator to swipe directly across the eyelid and blend out with finger or E3 brush (sold separately).
-Apply one shade all over eyelid for a soft layer of color.
-Apply and blend one eye at a time for the most even coverage.
-Using the E6 brush (sold separately), apply a deeper shade to the crease to contour and define the lid.
-Apply a lighter shade to the browbone, inner corner, or center of the lid to highlight.
-Apply a layer of shimmer for soft, reflective dimension and a pearlescent finish.

Pro Tips:
-To define the lash line, use Master Pigment Pro® Eye Pencil (sold separately).
-Use dual-ended brush to smudge and diffuse.
Ingredients+

Long-Wear Cream Eyeshadow - Mauve

-Smoothing Amino Acids and Spherical Powders: Deliver a smooth, soft, and silky feel and application.


Isododecane, Lauroyl Lysine, Microcrystalline Wax (Cera Microcristallina), Dextrin Palmitate, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Dicalcium Phosphate, Polyamide-3, Zinc Stearate, Mica, Octyldodecanol, Cetearyl Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax, Silica, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, May Contain: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Blue 1 Lake (Ci 42090).


Soft Shimmer™ Long-Wear Cream Eyeshadow - Pink Pearl

-Smoothing Amino Acids and Spherical Powders: Create a silky feel with immediate adhesion to the eyelid and all-day diffusion.


Isododecane, Mica, Lauroyl Lysine, Cera Microcristallina/Microcrystalline Wax/Cire Microcristalline, Dextrin Palmitate, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Polyamide-3, Zinc Stearate, Octyldodecanol, Cetearyl Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Candelilla Cera/Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax/Cire De Candelilla, Silica, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Dicalcium Phosphate, [+/-  Blue 1 Lake (Ci 42090), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Ferric Ferrocyanide (Ci 77510), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891).
